context: A coach trains a young prodigy; talks about training counts and a part-time job
purpose: Teach: コーチ/狙っ/天才/回数/アルバイト/チャンネル/加速/盛ん

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、来たな天才。今日も練習回数しっかりこなしていくで。
lines.en: Hey, the prodigy's here. We'll get the training reps in today too.
lines.style: Warm Kansai coach greeting, brisk and encouraging tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: コーチ、おはようございます。今日は全国大会を狙った特別メニューですよね？
lines.en: Coach, good morning. Today's the special menu aimed at nationals, right?
lines.style: Polite university-age student, focused and slightly nervous energy

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: そうや。ここから一気に加速していくで。最近この競技も盛んになってきとるしな。
lines.en: That's right. We're accelerating from here on. This sport's getting popular too.
lines.style: Confident Kansai coach explaining the plan with rising momentum

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 実は相談が…来月からカフェでアルバイトを始めようか迷ってて。
lines.en: Actually, I wanted to talk… I'm thinking of starting a part-time job at a cafe.
lines.style: Hesitant student broaching a sensitive topic carefully

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほう、なんでや？練習の回数減らすつもりちゃうやろな？
lines.en: Oh? Why's that? You're not planning to cut training sessions, are you?
lines.style: Kansai coach probing with mild concern, half-joking half-serious

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 違います。実家への仕送りが厳しくて。あと、自分のYouTubeチャンネルも育てたいんです。
lines.en: No. Sending money home is tight. Plus I want to grow my own YouTube channel.
lines.style: Earnest explanation from a responsible young adult, mature reasoning

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: なるほどな。お前は天才やけど、生活も大事や。バイトは週二回までにしとき。
lines.en: I see. You're a genius, but life matters too. Keep the job to twice a week.
lines.style: Pragmatic Kansai mentor balancing discipline with care

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます！絶対にトップを狙って結果出します。
lines.en: Thank you so much! I'll definitely aim for the top and deliver results.
lines.style: Grateful determined response from motivated student athlete
